en.title: Microsoft Edge Copilot: Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
en.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Edge Copilot for Android and iOS (CVE-2026-48561).

checks: Check Microsoft Edge Copilot installations on Android and iOS for the reported vulnerability.
